intent: Replace the triangular corner silhouette with three rounded cumulus groups separated by open white sky
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: decorative ASCII clouds entering the upper-left edge of a minimal personal website.
Reference image: match ONLY its upright monospaced ASCII texture, luminous ivory highlights, subdued blue-gray/sage shadows, and delicate contrast. Do not copy its composition.
Canvas: portrait 1024 x 1536 with perfectly flat pure white #FFFFFF background. The cloud artwork is confined to the LEFT 44% of this canvas; the remaining right 56% is completely empty white. This empty area is deliberate, for website text.
Composition: THREE recognizable, naturally rounded CUMULUS CLOUD GROUPS drift into view from beyond the left edge at different heights. Each group has a few large softly billowing domes, rounded undersides, internal cool shadow pockets, and delicate irregular edges. They must immediately read as puffy sky clouds, rather than a mountain, foliage, foam, or smoke. Use broad confident cloud lobes, not a dense carpet of dozens of tiny scallops.
The first cloud group is clipped by both top and left canvas edges, approximately y=0–27%, and extends to x=38%. The second group enters from the left at y=38–63% and extends farther, to x=44%. The third group enters from the left at y=76–95% and extends to x=40%; it ends in rounded cloud lobes, not a pointed tip. Vary their shapes and relative masses naturally. Keep clear white sky between groups, especially the horizontal bands y=29–35% and y=66–72%, including at the LEFT edge. The bottommost 4% is white. Their widest points must vary rather than steadily receding toward the left. The cumulative outer boundary must NOT be a diagonal, triangle, wedge, long taper, straight vertical wall, ribbon, oval, tree, or a stack of repeated icons.
Style: forms shaded by clearly visible upright @ # + = : . characters arranged in horizontal rows. Preserve the reference's painterly luminous cloud volumes and restrained palette while making the rounded cloud silhouettes obvious at small display sizes. No rotated glyphs, photographic grain, stippling-only shading, flat vector icon look, or outlined cartoon symbols.
Only airy cloud groups and white negative space. No sun, landscape, horizon, mountains, objects, words, logos, frame, border, gradients in the background, or drop shadows. Do not tint the empty background. Keep cloud colors close to the reference; the website adds its own subtle golden-hour tint.
